subject: Taxes
title: Tax Visibility and Anger
description: A quick, practical guide to Tax Visibility and Anger.

hook.text: Sales tax added at the register makes people angrier than the same tax embedded in the price.

buildup.text: Researchers tested this: identical products priced at $1.00 + 8% tax vs. $1.08 all-inclusive.

discovery.text: This is called 'tax salience.' The more visible a tax, the more people resist it—even if the amount is identical.

twist.text: Governments know this. Property tax is embedded in mortgages.

climax.text: Invisible taxes raise more revenue with less political backlash.

punchline.text: Same tax, different visibility. Hidden taxes face less resistance.

quiz.question: What is 'tax salience'?
options: The total amount of tax paid
How visible or noticeable a tax is to the payer
The fairness of a tax system
